name: seo-aeo-audit
summary: Audit answer-engine and SERP answer-feature readiness with source labels and no unsupported placement or visibility claims.
inputs: domain, market, language, audience, query set, pages, date, device, and scope
approved SERP, content, entity, schema, Brand, and first-party evidence
external_reads: approved SERP, provider, answer-engine, page, and first-party evidence
approval_gates: external_read: ask before live SERP, provider, answer-engine, or page reads
provider_data: paid or credentialed calls require approval
vault_write: save only to resolved context
external_mutation: content, schema, CMS, code, publishing, and production changes are out of scope
done_when: query, page, device, date, scope, source tier, confidence, and limitations are explicit
observed answer features remain distinct from heuristics and vendor studies
no SERP feature, answer, citation, ranking, or AI visibility is fabricated
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred
verification: verify unavailable sources produced no fabricated answer features or model outputs
verify no content, schema, CMS, code, publishing, provider, or production mutation occurred
verify changed artifact and review registration when applicable
